name: Star Thread
story: Comet is threading toy constellations through the celestial skylights. Each portal sees the lantern from a different side. Spend a little starlight to slow a gate when you need another turn.
objective: Guide seven lantern parcels through the portals to light the star road.
twist: Exact openings, changing wall direction and closing-beat bonuses combine. Two focus charges slow the current portal for 2.5 seconds without losing points.
rule: Fit seven lantern parcels through the star portals. U spends a focus charge to slow this wall; three bonks end the flight.
controls: E/Q: turn in 3D · Arrows/WASD: align on current wall · Space: send · U: focus slow time (2 charges)
opening_hint: E/Q turns the parcel; arrows align its outline with the gap. Space sends it through.
fail_text: The gates have closed. Try this route again!
